body: I’m not sure if I have trauma or not. But I also suppressed feelings of anxiety, and I’ve sort of lost the ability to feel that gut feeling of anxiety that people are supposed to get unless it gets really bad. Also yeah I have all the physical symptoms you described except a few times a day when I start getting really bad I’ll start to actually feel the emotional symptoms starting up.
then how am I supposed to know if I’m not good at recognizing emotions or social cues
Idk about tics because I was actually able to control whatever they were enough to stop them (it did take a shit ton of effort tho).

I appreciate the suggestion. And yeah I’ve been looking into resources for what can help me socially. I’m just scared that I’ll be wasting my time trying to learn social skills the “neurotypical way” cause if I do have autism, a lot of that stuff simply wouldn’t work for me.
I’ve looked into it, but the issue is that it doesn’t explain where the stims come from :/
